menuPage.title: Menu
menuPage.subtitle: 削る、香る、味わう。 Shaved, Aromatic, Tasteful.
menuPage.allergyNote: Please ask our staff about allergies.
menuPage.seasonalNote: Please ask our staff about today's seasonal item.
menuPage.brownSugarNote: All SAKEGORI (shaved ice) are served with freshly shaved Okinawan brown sugar. If you'd prefer not to have it, please let our staff know.
menuPage.setDescription: Any SAKEGORI (Alcohol or Non-Alcoholic) + Any Drink Of Your Choice

yuzuSparkling.name: Yuzu Sparkling Sake
yuzuSparkling.description: A refreshingly light sparkling sake from Oita, brightened with yuzu citrus.

juliaSparkling.name: Julia Sparkling Sake
juliaSparkling.description: A crisp, refreshing junmai-based sparkling sake.

todaysSake.name: Today's Sake
todaysSake.description: Ask our staff about today's selection, served warm or chilled.

white.name: White
white.descriptionAlcohol: A creamy, milk-based ice gently laced with junmai sake, finished with a dusting of freshly shaved black sugar — smooth, comforting, and quietly warming.
white.descriptionNonAlcohol: A creamy, milk-based ice sweetened with our housemade amazake, finished with shaved black sugar — gentle, comforting, and naturally sweet.

black.name: Black
black.descriptionAlcohol: Rich milk ice deepened with junmai sake and black sugar syrup, finished with a generous shaving of black sugar — dark, creamy, and warmly sweet.
black.descriptionNonAlcohol: Rich milk ice deepened with housemade amazake and black sugar syrup, finished with a generous shaving of black sugar — dark, creamy, and warmly sweet.

matcha.name: Matcha
matcha.descriptionAlcohol: Whisked matcha folded into velvety milk with a gentle warmth of coffee liqueur, finished with shaved black sugar — earthy, creamy, and quietly bold.
matcha.descriptionNonAlcohol: Whisked matcha folded into velvety milk and housemade amazake, finished with shaved black sugar — earthy, creamy, and naturally sweet.

coffee.name: Coffee
coffee.descriptionAlcohol: Silky milk ice warmed with coffee liqueur, finished with a dusting of shaved black sugar — bittersweet, creamy, and smooth.
coffee.descriptionNonAlcohol: Silky milk ice sweetened with housemade amazake and coffee syrup, finished with shaved black sugar — smooth, roasty, and comforting.

seasonal.name: Seasonal
seasonal.descriptionAlcohol: A rotating, limited-time creation — recent editions have featured a plum wine-infused ice finished with shaved black sugar. Ask our staff what's pouring today.
seasonal.descriptionNonAlcohol: A rotating, limited-time creation — recent editions have featured a sparkling kabosu-citrus ice. Ask our staff what's featured today.

cafeLatte.name: Cafe Latte
cafeLatte.description: House coffee and black sugar syrup swirled with housemade amazake and milk over ice — smooth, roasty, and gently sweet.

matchaLatte.name: Matcha Latte
matchaLatte.description: Whisked matcha and milk over ice, dusted with matcha powder — earthy, fragrant, and lightly sweet.

brownSugarLatte.name: Brown Sugar Latte
brownSugarLatte.description: Black sugar syrup and housemade amazake swirled with milk over ice, finished with shaved black sugar — deep, creamy, and comforting.

kabosuSoda.name: Kabosu Soda
kabosuSoda.description: Kabosu citrus syrup topped with tonic water over ice, garnished with fresh kabosu — crisp, tart, and refreshing.

condensedMilk.name: Condensed Milk
condensedMilk.description: A drizzle of rich condensed milk for extra creaminess.

shavedBrownSugar.name: Shaved Brown Sugar
shavedBrownSugar.description: An extra flurry of freshly shaved Okinawan brown sugar.

roastedSoybeanFlour.name: Roasted Soybean Flour
roastedSoybeanFlour.description: Nutty, toasted kinako for warm, roasted depth.
